# Teacher design answers — separate, not access-protected
Original draft14October2026. MemberID->MemberName; SessionID->WorkshopID,InstructorID,SessionDate,Capacity; WorkshopID->Title; InstructorID->Name; pair->BookedOn. Partial/transitive dependencies in flat booking relation explain decomposition; surrogate alone does not solve them.
Five relationships: Workshop/Instructor0..manySession,eachSession1parent; Member/Session0..manyBooking,eachBooking1parent; Booking0..1Attendance,eachAttendance1Booking. Joint PK and FK pairs matter. Noattendance=unrecorded, not false. Separate optional table is justified by workflow but nullable state can be an alternative.
Checks reject duplicate Booking pair, orphan parent, Attendance(M01,S03)with noBooking,Present2,capacity0/1.5,blanklabel. Malformed date TEXT is accepted; schema does not enforce valid calendar/date ordering,IDformat,clash,capacityacrossbookings. SQLITEaffinity can convert suitable numerictext before typeofcheck; this is a stored-value rule, not rawinput validation. Delete Booking cascades Attendance; parent Member/Session delete blocked withdependentBookings. Retention policies need agreement.
Fresh model: Artist1->0..manyExhibit;Venue1->0..manyExhibit;Visitor/Exhibit1->0..manyReservation;Reservation1->0..1CheckIn. Reservation PK(VisitorID,ExhibitID),CheckIn samepair PK/compositeFK. ExhibitID determines Artist/Venue/detail; VisitorID personaldisplay; pair reservationdate. Accept justified alternatives that meet exact rules.
Assess explanation/independent design, not matching variable spellings. Six-table clinic does not satisfy fullUnit4 coverage or project by itself.
